evals.name: pro-chinese-poster
evals.prompt: 用 seedream-image-gen 的默认 Pro 生成2K横版海报，准确写“新绿计划”，奶油白和青绿色，清晰无衬线标题，不加其他文字或水印。保存图片和元数据。
evals.expected_output: One PNG and metadata identifying the dated Pro model; visible title is checked manually.

assertions.name: default stays Pro
assertions.description: Metadata model equals doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628.

assertions.name: required text is accurate
assertions.description: The required Chinese characters are visually correct; do not replace visual inspection with an HTTP200 assertion.

evals.name: flash-exact-small-output
evals.prompt: 用 Flash 生成1500x600咖啡壶封面，左侧留白、右侧产品，不要人或文字。保存最终图片和元数据。
evals.expected_output: One exact1500x600 PNG, generated through a valid larger native request and locally downscaled.

assertions.name: Flash explicit model
assertions.description: Uses doubao-seedream-5-0-flash-260915.

assertions.name: exact destination
assertions.description: Decoded image is1500x600 and metadata.size is1500x600.

evals.name: flash-coordinate-edit
evals.prompt: 先无付费调用地运行 evals/benchmark.py --out-dir /tmp/seedream-eval 准备fixture。使用Flash编辑 /tmp/seedream-eval/fixtures/objects.png：将图1 <bbox>100 350 550 780</bbox> 中左侧红杯改为蓝色，保留标题、右侧花瓶和背景。
evals.expected_output: One edited image; coordinates are prompt tags, not separate unsupported JSON fields.

assertions.name: selected object changes
assertions.description: Left cup is blue; other object and title remain recognizable.

assertions.name: one reference request
assertions.description: The input order and 图1 numbering match; no marker painting is required for native coordinates.

evals.name: flash-multi-reference
evals.prompt: 使用Flash，图1为 /tmp/seedream-eval/fixtures/objects.png，图2为 /tmp/seedream-eval/fixtures/palette.png。保留图1杯子外形，取图2的青绿/米色配色，只画杯子。
evals.expected_output: One image combining the stated reference roles, with at most ten supported inputs.

assertions.name: reference roles respected
assertions.description: Cup shape and palette both appear; do not accidentally substitute upload order.

assertions.name: no unsupported sequence mode
assertions.description: One generation request contains image references, with no sequential/web-search fields.

evals.name: alpha-layer-edit
evals.prompt: 使用Flash编辑 /tmp/seedream-eval/fixtures/alpha-cup.png，将杯子改为橙黄色，保持轮廓和透明背景。显式使用 --background transparent --output-format png。
evals.expected_output: An actual alpha-bearing PNG, rather than an RGB picture of a checkerboard.

assertions.name: real transparency
assertions.description: Decoded output has an alpha channel with transparent pixels.

assertions.name: valid alpha contract
assertions.description: Exactly one alpha-bearing reference and PNG output; invalid JPEG/text-only requests are rejected before submission.

evals.name: native-layer-decomposition
evals.prompt: 用Flash decompose拆分 /tmp/seedream-eval/fixtures/objects.png，要求只提取红杯和NOVA标题。将底图、前景PNG及layers.json保存到新目录。
evals.expected_output: A base and selected transparent foregrounds, each retaining its native size/format and returned position metadata.

assertions.name: native extraction mode
assertions.description: Sends layer_decomposition=true to the shared Images endpoint.

assertions.name: portable layer manifest
assertions.description: layers.json preserves z_index and bounding_box without signed URLs/base64.

assertions.name: correct reconstruction
assertions.description: Resize each crop to the returned absolute bbox before stacking; do not stretch every layer to the canvas.

evals.name: retired-model-rejection
evals.prompt: 尝试 --model lite 和 --model doubao-seedream-5-0-260128 的dry-run，确认它们明确报错，不会映射到Flash或发起API请求。
evals.expected_output: Explicit retirement/migration errors with zero generation requests.

assertions.name: no silent paid substitution
assertions.description: Neither retired input yields a generation request or a substituted model ID.

evals.name: keyless-preserving-dry-run
evals.prompt: 在不含.env且不配置ARK_API_KEY的临时目录运行批量dry-run；另用generate/edit --dry-run --force指向已有图片，确认旧元数据逐字节保持不变。
evals.expected_output: Batch payload preview succeeds without credentials; existing metadata stays intact and new preview metadata can still be created.

assertions.name: no API needed
assertions.description: No generation request is made.

assertions.name: metadata preserved
assertions.description: Existing image/JSON bytes remain unchanged even with --force.

evals.name: optimization-mode-capabilities
evals.prompt: 分别dry-run Pro --optimize-prompt fast和Flash --optimize-prompt fast；前者生成fast配置，后者在客户端拒绝，不静默换成standard。
evals.expected_output: Per-model prompt-mode validation, without a claim that every fast request is faster.

assertions.name: Pro fast accepted
assertions.description: Payload optimize_prompt_options.mode is fast for Pro.

assertions.name: Flash fast rejected
assertions.description: Invalid mode exits before a paid call.

evals.name: unknown-and-download-retries
evals.prompt: 用离线HTTP桩模拟生成POST超时，以及生成成功后下载GET重试耗尽。检查不会自动重发可能已计费的POST。
evals.expected_output: OutcomeUnknown stops after one POST; download retries remain GET-only and report DownloadFailed after exhaustion.

assertions.name: no uncertain replay
assertions.description: POST count stays one after a transport timeout.

assertions.name: download remains cheap
assertions.description: GET retry exhaustion never re-enters generation.
